Our Dental Services

Complete dental care under one roof

From routine check-ups to advanced laser and implant procedures — explore our treatments and book the one you need.

General Dental Check-ups

Routine oral examinations to catch problems early and keep your teeth and gums healthy.

Digital Dental X-rays

Low-radiation digital imaging for accurate diagnosis of hidden dental issues.

Teeth Cleaning & Polishing

Professional scaling and polishing to remove plaque, tartar, and surface stains.

Tooth-Coloured Fillings

Natural-looking composite fillings that restore decayed or chipped teeth.

Root Canal Treatment (RCT)

Gentle, precise endodontic care to save infected or badly damaged teeth.

Tooth Extraction

Safe, comfortable removal of teeth that cannot be saved.

Wisdom Tooth Removal

Assessment and removal of problematic or impacted wisdom teeth.

Dental Crowns & Bridges

Custom crowns and bridges to restore strength, function, and appearance.

Complete & Partial Dentures

Removable replacements that restore missing teeth and confident chewing.

Dental Implants

Stable, natural-looking titanium replacements for missing teeth.

Smile Designing

A personalised plan combining treatments to transform your smile.

Tooth Jewel

Subtle decorative gems bonded safely to add a little sparkle to your smile.

Teeth Whitening (Bleaching)

Professional whitening to brighten stained or discoloured teeth.

Cosmetic Dentistry

Aesthetic corrections including bonding and reshaping for a brighter smile.

Dental Veneers

Thin, custom shells that improve the shape, colour, and alignment of teeth.

Orthodontic Treatment (Braces)

Fixed braces to correct crowding, gaps, and bite alignment.

Clear Aligners

Discreet, removable aligners that straighten teeth gradually.

Pediatric Dentistry

Friendly, reassuring dental care designed for children's smiles.

Gum Disease Treatment

Scaling and root planing to treat gum disease and restore gum health.

Bleeding Gums & Flap Surgery

Treatment for bleeding gums, including flap surgery where needed.

Dental Emergency Care

Prompt attention for dental pain, injuries, and urgent problems.

Skin Tag Removal

Safe removal of oral and perioral skin tags using modern techniques.

Gum Designing

Reshaping the gum line to create a balanced, even smile.

Tongue-Tie Removal

A simple procedure to release a restrictive tongue-tie.

Operculectomy

Removal of the gum flap over a partially erupted wisdom tooth.

Frenectomy

Release of a tight lip or tongue frenum to improve movement and function.

Gum Depigmentation

Lightening of dark gum pigmentation for a more even, pink appearance.

De-Sensitisation

Targeted treatment to relieve tooth sensitivity to hot, cold, and sweet foods.

Technology

Laser & implant dentistry, explained simply

Modern tools that support precise, comfort-focused care. Your dentist will always explain whether a technology suits your specific case.

Laser Dentistry

Dental lasers are used in select procedures involving gums and soft tissues. They allow a focused, minimally invasive approach where appropriate.

  • Designed to be gentle on surrounding tissue
  • May mean less drilling noise for select procedures
  • Suitability is assessed during your consultation

Dental Implants

An implant replaces the root of a missing tooth with a small titanium post that supports a natural-looking crown — a long-term option for many patients.

  • Planned with detailed imaging and measurements
  • Designed to look, feel, and work like a natural tooth
  • Requires healthy gums and adequate bone — evaluated first

Equipment we use

Laser Technology

Precise, minimally invasive laser-assisted care for select soft-tissue and gum procedures.

Apex Locator

Electronic root canal measurement for accurate, reliable endodontic treatment.

Ultrasonic Equipment

Advanced ultrasonic scalers for thorough, comfortable cleaning and treatment.

Every treatment plan begins with a clinical examination. Outcomes vary from person to person — your dentist will discuss options, benefits, and limitations with you before you decide.

About Doctor

Meet your dentist

Care led by a specialist who believes in saving natural teeth first — and explaining every option clearly.

Dr. Nishchita B L

Endodontist & Implantologist

Dr. Nishchita B L leads clinical care at Silver Edge Dental Clinic. Her practice focuses on saving natural teeth through root canal treatment, replacing missing teeth with dental implants, and using modern laser-assisted techniques where appropriate. She is known for a calm, patient-centered approach — explaining options clearly and tailoring every treatment plan to the individual.

  • Root canal & endodontic care
  • Dental implant planning & placement
  • Laser-assisted dental procedures
